OTQ-F2-1.mechanism: GeoCeDG-owned client EventListener on app.getEventDispatcher(), registered at the first slot write; reset(), UNDO, REDO clear both slots; REMOVE, REDEFINE re-validate; exact-instance check before every reuse

OTQ-F2-2.evidence: input[0] = point, input[1] = reference in the four algorithms (source); 12 of 12 admitted routes confirmed at runtime
OTQ-F2-2.successDetection: super.switchModeForProcessMode returns true for a non-preview call; getJustCreatedGeos() holds only this step's output (cleared otherwise); certificate of design §4.3 applied

OTQ-F2-3.predicate: exact-instance member AND admissible AND isDefined AND isEuclidianVisible AND isVisibleInView(GV1) AND app.isLayerShown(layer)

linearFunctionDomain.limitation: constant functions have getX() = NaN (degree-0 polynomial has no getCoeffs()[1]); the inherited tools create no line from them; not remembered; not broadened

closeoutCandidate: the direct child of 09bb6302 containing this file; identity and STATIC reported outside the record

DQ-F2-1.decision: memories survive ordinary tool changes within the same application document session; not serialized

DQ-F2-2.previous: S1 two slots, replaced on success
DQ-F2-2.decision: two independent slots (parallel, perpendicular); a newly selected admissible reference replaces the slot only after a successful construction; cancellation or failure never replaces a valid slot

DQ-F2-3.previous: G1 point-first includes empty space; #2610 unchanged
DQ-F2-3.decision: with a valid memory an existing point or empty space may start a construction; without memory an explicit reference is required; no invented reference or unintended geometry; point-on-path preserved; no press-time pre-seeding where it conflicts; release-time injection if the tool flows prove it correct

DQ-F2-4.previous: R1 accepted references with a labelled 2D output
DQ-F2-4.decision: 2D lines, segments, rays, polygon edges, appropriate 2D vectors and linear functions; the reference actually used by the successful kernel algorithm; a label is never the sole certificate; unsupported and 3D inputs keep inherited behavior and are not remembered
DQ-F2-4.difference: labelled-output criterion replaced by the success certificate (algorithm class, exact-instance membership, defined output, input[1])

DQ-F2-5.previous: MB identity; suspend; lazy plus document-boundary clearing; undo forgets
DQ-F2-5.decision: exact object reference only; exact-instance membership; label lookup only corroborates; clear on removal, replacement, staleness, New, Open, full document replacement and undo/redo rebuilds; keep across rename and same-instance recompute; temporary invalidity or invisibility suspends reuse; no durable IDs, identity infrastructure or document associations
DQ-F2-5.difference: undo/redo rebuilds clear eagerly instead of lazily; observable behavior identical

DQ-F2-6.previous: C1 release-time seeding, no preview, no indicator
DQ-F2-6.decision: no preview or memory indicator in v1; preview never updates memory; memory updates only on a committed construction; no undo point for memory

DQ-F2-7.decision: GeoCeDG controller-companion override of createAngle(GeoPointND, GeoPointND, GeoNumberValue, boolean); call sites verified; tool route only; hidden before the inherited undo store; AlgoDispatcher.angle, Angle(...), GGBScript and shared algorithms unchanged

DQ-F2-8.previous: V1 hidden in graphics views only
DQ-F2-8.decision: angle hidden in the graphical views by ordinary visibility; valid dependent object accessible in the Algebra View; rotated point visible; user may show it; save, reload, undo, redo unchanged; interception only in GeoCeDG GV1; visibility is not a per-view overlay; GV2 controller and Classic unchanged

DQ-F2-9.decision: ENH-R6PLUS-WORKING-LAYER-DIRECT-ENTRY remains a separate pending enhancement, not implemented in F2; tracking and status preserved

DQ-F2-10.decision: Desktop-only orchestration and a GeoCeDG-owned controller companion; BOUNDED_PHASE with one registered PHASE subject to the entry gate; no shared kernel, command, XML schema, global identity or inherited-class change; missing seams stop for author review

read-back route (getJustCreatedGeos after super, or a wrapped release callback)
